name: Fuefuki (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Fuefuki city emblem in white: a stylised letter F of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Fuefuki, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 2004; the emblem dates from 12 October 2004.

features.role: Fuefuki city emblem — a stylised letter F of curved strokes
